description: This file defines a PHP class 'SaleTax' that extends a controller in the OpenCart admin system, specifically handling sale tax reporting functionalities including display, save, and list operations.

classes.name: SaleTax
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling sale tax report operations within the OpenCart admin extension system, including displaying the report form, saving report settings, and generating the report list.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the sale tax report form within the admin interface, setting up breadcrumbs, loading language and model components, and rendering the form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the saving of sale tax report configuration settings, with permission check and JSON response indicating success or error.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Prepares and displays the sale tax report overview page, including report data, pagination, and filters.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves filtered report data based on user input, formatting date ranges, aggregating report results, and returning the report view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a JSON list of sale tax reports based on current filtering criteria.
